title: ClearSpeak
description: Developed a Raspberry Pi–powered speech assistant using machine learning to help people with speech disabilities communicate through accurate voice recognition.

title: CourtVision
description: NBA analytics platform that converts natural-language questions into statistical visualizations, allowing users to explore team performance metrics like offensive rating, efficiency, and pace through interactive charts.

title: FIFA WC Predictor
description: Machine learning–based FIFA World Cup prediction system that uses historical match data, Elo ratings, FIFA rankings, recent form, and advanced match features to predict wins, draws, and losses.

title: HoopIQ
description: Full-stack NBA analytics platform for predictive player evaluation, salary analysis, and advanced statistical modeling using historical NBA statistics and contract data.

title: March Metrics
description: Full-stack NCAA basketball analytics platform for team rankings, matchup simulation, bracket generation, and tournament decision support using a custom 20-metric March Score system.

title: Rentify App
description: Rentify is a mobile Android app that connects people who want to rent out their items (Lessors) with those looking to rent (Renters).

title: Embedded Systems Lab – Alarm System & Linear Pong Game
description: Developed STM32-based Alarm System and LED Pong Game demonstrating real-time I²C, GPIO, and state-machine control.

title: UART-Enabled Traffic Light Controller
description: Developed a UART-enabled traffic light controller on an Altera DE2 FPGA using structural VHDL, finite state machines, and real-time serial communication.

title: BudgetBuddy
description: BudgetBuddy is a mobile Android app that helps users manage income, track expenses, and visualize monthly budgets.
